prompt: In a disposable Git repository, create a feature branch whose latest ordinary commit is named 'fix typo' but has no fixup! or squash! commits. Ask the autosquash workflow to clean the branch. Save its report and before/after refs to outputs/.
assertions: ordinary-commit-untouched: the branch SHA and commit subject remain unchanged
no-markers-no-op: the report explicitly says no fixup! or squash! commits were found
no-push: no remote update is attempted
